title: 🔥资金回流比特币避险
body: 市场结构呈二八分化。BTC.D 为 58.7%，且 7 日变化达 +0.3%。在 BTC 价格仅微涨的背景下，主导率逆势上扬，说明资金正在加速从其他资产抽离并回流比特币。存量资金被 BTC 吸纳，市场难以走出普涨行情。中性。你还在持有弱势币吗？
title_en: 🔥 Capital Rotates Back to BTC as a Safe Haven
body_en: Market structure is showing a clear divergence. BTC.D stands at 58.7%, with a 7-day change of +0.3%. With BTC price barely moving, dominance is bucking the trend—this indicates capital is accelerating its rotation out of other assets and flowing back into Bitcoin. Liquidity is being absorbed by BTC, so a broad market rally is unlikely. Neutral. Still holding weak coins?
